## Using a preset

1. Choose the preset for your pack version and loader, and read its compatibility notes. A playtest preset is still being evaluated in normal gameplay.
2. Install the supplied editable configuration files and any included datapack using that preset's instructions.
3. Rebuild and validate balance on the server or integrated single-player server, then check the results in the Ascendance Archive. Restarting alone does not replace an existing generated profile.

These downloads contain configuration inputs, not mod jars, worlds, player records or a cached generated balance. Using them in a different pack is a starting point for your own tuning, not a claim of compatibility.

New packs and retuned versions are added as separate entries. [Maintainer instructions and editable sources](https://github.com/mistaboom/essence_ascendance/tree/main/presets) explain how to add another preset without replacing existing downloads.
